1. Put the iPhone in DFU (screen black).
2. Connect via USB-C OTG / USB host.
3. Grant root (KernelSU or Magisk).
4. Tap Exploit for pwned DFU only, or Jailbreak for full palera1n.

checkm8 (gaster): A5–A11 / T2.
palera1n jailbreak: A8–A11 / T2, iOS/iPadOS/tvOS 15–26 (rootless default). A11: disable passcode; on iOS 16 reset first. A12+ will not work.
